title: CIC interrogates Viktor Schauberger for nine months

tellings.quote: According to historian Nick Cook's great book, The Hunt for Zero Point, CIC agents interrogated Shaburgger for nine months, fully aware of his most classified work.

plain: After the Second World War, agents of the Counter Intelligence Corps, the US Army's counterintelligence service, questioned a researcher named Viktor Schauberger for nine months, fully aware of his most classified work. Michels tells this from the historian Nick Cook's book The Hunt for Zero Point, which he calls great. The point is that the Americans saw Schauberger's secret wartime work in Austria and Germany as worth months of close attention.
